atomic: all tiles computed before sink; cancel/stale/sink error -> no receipt; plane immutable; sha256 in receipt; route recorded (scalar only, sse2 refused)

profile transform: ProfileConverter port + PrismConverter (admitted inspection of both profiles: verified linear-light descriptors under the caller ledger, plus WideEngine admission), then conversion through Prism WideEngine in requests of at most WIDE_CHUNK_PIXELS=262144 (limit 2097152; with_chunk_pixels), relative colorimetric / BPC off; plan cache => each profile parsed once per frame (receipt profile_stats: plan hits/misses/parses); range refusal outside 0..1 never clipped; output unclamped and destination values outside 0..1 counted in receipt profile_stats.clip (method, pixels, per-channel, max overshoot); identity skip only after inspection; receipt profile_route prism_admitted_wide + profile_calls (requests); independent ICC colorant oracle test (1e-4) unchanged and green; the wide transform is NOT charged to the caller admission ledger (bounded by request size, 2 MiB profiles, 8 plans)
observe: report() outcome mapping (incl. Prism codes), DESCRIPTOR, develop-consumer example

dng: classic TIFF IFD walk (bounded), SubIFD raw selection, strips/tiles with checked sizes, uncompressed 8/16-bit LE/BE, lossless JPEG (compression 7), LinearizationTable, per-site BlackLevel repeat + BlackLevelDeltaH/V, WhiteLevel, ActiveArea, DefaultCrop, raw-IFD-scoped tag lookup, cfa_plane windows (Refuse | ClampReported counted), unapplied-feature report (opcode lists, default scale/user crop, profile maps, orientation)

colour: DNG camera->XYZ D50 (CM/FM two-profile mired interpolation, iterative white from AsShotNeutral or AsShotWhiteXY, Robertson 1968 CCT, Bradford, ForwardMatrix and ColorMatrix paths with the same neutral->D50 Y=1 convention), recipe built from DNG tags with BaselineExposure policy

scalar speed (no SIMD, no unsafe, output byte-identical, pinned by develop_digest): demosaic stencil per (row phase, column phase, missing channel) with linear offsets in the reference summation order (sites within 2 samples of an edge use the original reflect routine), CfaPlane channel lookup table used by admission and normalisation, row-wise tile/alpha/coverage writes without per-pixel division, develop_to_image row copy, exposure == 1 with no curve skips only the identity multiply (finiteness refusal kept), curve segment found by branch-free count, stage-A products unchecked only when every gain/coefficient is 0 or within 1e-100..1e100 (then no product can overflow or round to zero; the f32 rounding refusals are kept)
